output.summary: Trial K randomized 84 adults. At 12 weeks, the intervention group experienced a mean systolic pressure decrease of 3 mmHg, with a confidence interval including zero.
Battery B completed 500 cycles with 91% capacity retention at 25 °C, using three cells.
The assay detected E7 in 18 of 24 samples. Two failed quality control; authors marked results preliminary.
A cross-sectional survey of 312 students found that sleep under six hours correlated with fatigue, but causality was not tested.
16 rain-fed plots measured maize yield during one drought season, with median yield 4.2 t/ha
Model A achieved 0.81 and Model B 0.79 accuracy on held-out data (n=900). Differences were not statistically tested.
At 25 °C, polymer P conductivity was 1.8 mS/cm (n=5); another protocol measured 1.2 mS/cm.
Compound R reduced symptom score by 2 points in 7 of 20 uncontrolled cases. No comparison group was used.
The pre-registered experiment included 40 people, with 36 completing follow-up at 6 months. Attrition reasons were not reported.
Dataset Kappa contains 84 rows. Missing values are substituted using median substitution, and results are preliminary.
CRISPR-Cas9 edits occurred at two candidate off-target sites in vitro, with no in-vivo assay performed.
The review included 11 studies but rated certainty low due to imprecision and inconsistency.
Median recovery 9 days (IQR 6–14) among 52 participants; one lost to follow-up
d=0.4, 95% CI −0.1 to 0.9, n=28. Interval includes no effect
Study A reported 12% uptake; Study B reported 9% with a different instrument. Results are not comparable.
No significant mortality difference (RR 0.98, 95% CI 0.81–1.19) observed after 2 years.
Cultures received 5 μM for 24 h. Viability fell 8%; biological replicates n=3
Urban cohort n=120 and rural cohort n=98 had different adverse-event rates; ascertainment differed by site.
Authors observed a possible yield increase but state the sample is underpowered and estimate uncertain.
pH 7.0 ΔG° −12.4 kJ/mol; pH 6.0 ΔG° −10.1 kJ/mol (model-derived)
